faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Short answers to the things parents and students ask us most.

subjects.q: Which subjects and grade levels does Mamopedia cover?
subjects.a: Mamopedia supports core subjects taught in Iraqi primary and secondary schools, including mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, Arabic, English, and social studies. Coverage expands continuously based on pilot feedback.

languages.q: Which languages can my child use to ask questions?
languages.a: Students can chat in Arabic, Kurdish (Sorani), or English. Mamopedia automatically detects the language of each question and responds in the same language.

free.a: Yes. During our pilot program the core experience is free. We'll announce any paid plans well in advance and always keep a free tier available for students.

privacy.q: How do you protect student privacy and data?
privacy.aBefore: We minimize what we collect and never sell student data. Conversations are used to improve learning recommendations and are protected with modern encryption. See our

ages.q: What ages is Mamopedia designed for?
ages.a: The experience is tuned for students roughly ages 10-18 and adapts its tone and difficulty based on the grade level you set. Younger children should use it with adult supervision.

offline.a: Mamopedia currently needs an internet connection to generate personalized answers and quizzes. We're exploring a lightweight offline study pack for areas with limited connectivity.

collect.p: We may collect the information you provide directly (such as name, email, and messages), and technical data such as device type, browser, and usage analytics to improve the Service.

use.p: We use your information to provide and improve Mamopedia, respond to support requests, personalize learning, and communicate important updates.

share.p: We do not sell personal data. We may share information with trusted service providers who help us operate the Service, under strict confidentiality and data protection requirements.

security.p: We use industry-standard safeguards to protect your information. No system is perfectly secure, but we work continuously to keep data safe.

children.p: Mamopedia is designed for students. We collect only the information necessary to provide the Service and encourage parental involvement where appropriate.

rights.p: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us.

acceptance.p: By accessing or using Mamopedia ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

use.p: Mamopedia is provided as an educational companion for Iraqi students. You agree to use it lawfully and respectfully. You are responsible for any content you submit and for maintaining the security of your account.

disclaimer.p: Mamopedia is offered on an "as is" basis. While we strive for accuracy, AI-generated content may contain errors. Always verify important information with a qualified teacher or trusted source.

changes.p: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Service after changes indicates acceptance of the updated Terms.
